headlines.title_en: Shenzhen new home sales in July up over 30% year on year
headlines.summary_en: According to data from the Shenzhen Real Estate Information Platform, new commercial housing transactions in the city totaled 3,773 units in July, down 35.2% month-on-month and up 19.3% year-on-year; among these, residential transactions reached 2,664 units, down 6.8% month-on-month and up 32.5% year-on-year. Over a longer period, cumulative new home transactions from January to July reached 35,104 units, a slight increase of 0.7% year-on-year; residential transactions totaled 21,935 units, down 10.6% year-on-year, with the decline narrowing compared to the first half of the year.

headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.title: 花旗：日本捍卫日元不必抛售逾1.1万亿美元的美债持仓
headlines.summary: 花旗集团表示，日本在捍卫日元时不必抛售逾1.1万亿美元的美国公债持仓，即使其可动用的短期债券持有部位已所剩不多，仍有其他工具可供运用。以Jason Williams为首的策略师表示，日本当局可以动用美联储的“海外和国际货币管理当局回购交易安排”(FIMA Repo Facility)。该机制允许海外央行以持有的美国公债作为抵押，向美联储取得美元流动性，无须出售公债筹措现金。花旗指出，日本还可以动用存放在外国央行的1,600亿美元存款，其中大部分可能存放在美联储相关机构中，或使用欧元资产购买日元。

headlines.title_en: Citi: Japan need not sell over $1.1 trillion in US Treasury holdings to defend yen
headlines.summary_en: Citigroup said Japan does not need to sell its over $1.1 trillion holdings of U.S. Treasuries to defend the yen, and even though its available short-term bond holdings are running thin, other tools remain available. Strategists led by Jason Williams said Japanese authorities can use the Federal Reserve's Foreign and International Monetary Authorities Repo Facility (FIMA Repo Facility), which allows foreign central banks to pledge U.S. Treasury holdings as collateral to obtain dollar liquidity from the Fed without selling the bonds. Citigroup noted that Japan could also draw on $160 billion in deposits held at foreign central banks, most of which may be parked at Fed-related institutions, or use euro assets to buy yen.

headlines.title_en: August 4 midday close: ChiNext Index up 4.83% for half-day, computing and chip sectors rebound collectively
headlines.summary_en: 1. The Shanghai Composite Index traded in a narrow range in the morning, while the ChiNext Index rose over 4%. CPO and other computing hardware stocks strengthened, with Yongding Shares, Dongshan Precision, and others hitting daily limits, while Tianfu Communication, Zhongji Innolight, and Eoptolink all rose over 10%. Semiconductor chip stocks rebounded, with Jinhaitong hitting the daily limit, and Heylin Micro, Xinxiang Micro, and others rising over 10%. Pharmaceutical and medical stocks were active, with WuXi AppTec, Ha Sanlian, Asymchem, and others hitting daily limits. Computing power leasing concepts rose, with Hongjing Technology, Xingyun Technology, and Jialitu hitting daily limits. On the downside, the banking sector fell, with the four major state-owned banks—ICBC, ABC, BOC, and CCB—all down about 3%. Advancers outnumbered decliners, with about 3,700 stocks in the red across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets, and morning turnover reached 1.37 trillion yuan. headlines.summary_zh: 【8月4日午间新闻精选】1、截至午间收盘，沪指涨0.16%，深证成指涨2.74%，创业板指涨4.83%。恒生指数跌0.49%，恒生科技指数跌0.19%。2、工业和信息化部召开光伏行业座谈会，进一步解读宣贯光伏组件强制性国家标准。3、据深圳市房地产信息平台数据，7月全市新建商品房共计成交3773套，环比下跌35.2%，同比上涨19.3%；其中住宅成交2664套，环比下跌6.8%，同比上涨32.5%。
headlines.summary_en: [August 4 midday news selection] 1. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.16%, the Shenzhen Component Index rose 2.74%, and the ChiNext Index rose 4.83%. The Hang Seng Index fell 0.49%, and the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 0.19%. 2. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology held a photovoltaic industry symposium to further interpret and promote mandatory national standards for photovoltaic modules. 3. According to data from the Shenzhen Real Estate Information Platform, new commercial housing transactions in the city totaled 3,773 units in July, down 35.2% month-on-month and up 19.3% year-on-year; residential transactions reached 2,664 units, down 6.8% month-on-month and up 32.5% year-on-year.

headlines.title_en: ChiNext Index rises over 2%, Shanghai Composite up 0.1%, Shenzhen Component up 1.38%; pharma/healthcare, CPO, and computing leasing lead gains; over 3,900 stocks rise across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets
headlines.summary_en: The ChiNext Index rose over 2%, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.1%, and the Shenzhen Component Index rose 1.38%, with pharmaceutical/medical, CPO, and computing power leasing sectors leading gains. More than 3,900 stocks rose across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets.

headlines.title_en: Several ChiNext AI ETFs surge over 8%
headlines.summary_en: ChiNext Artificial Intelligence ETFs—ChinaAMC (159371), Fullgoal (159246), and Guotai (159388)—rose over 8%; Communication ETFs—Guotai (515880) and ChinaAMC (515050)—rose over 7%; in the afternoon, the ChiNext Index rose over 5%, with the CPO sector strengthening, as Eoptolink, Zhongji Innolight, and Tianfu Communication all rose over 12%.
